StatDef.label: biomass extraction speed
StatDef.description: Extraction skill speed is 100% at or below reference levels Cooking 10, Medicine 6, Intellectual 4. Above reference each skill independently improves speed, weighted 40/40/20, up to 200% by default at level 20. General work speed, sight and manipulation apply separately.

StatDef.label: biomass extraction yield
StatDef.description: Raw recovery is capped at recipe yield. Below-reference skills cause weighted random wastage, rolled once at completion, with at least one biomass recovered. Above-reference skills do not increase yield.
